fixes: Record each modified node and Blueprint in the undo transaction.
Require a unique explicit graph name instead of silently selecting a graph.
Refuse invalid or colliding short node identifiers before planning.
Require measured node bounds before collision planning.
Check coordinates and target positions before applying; notify graph changes.
Avoid claiming no issues remain when no safe movement was planned.
Carry exclusive pure producers atomically, refusing chains longer than eight nodes without partial movement.
Use measured bounds to detect backward connections and preserve every comment membership.
Keep forced no-ops clean; disclose estimated wire-length non-improvement.
Clarify live help, parameters, limits, comments and preview rule counts.

Exclusive pure producers were not carried and the over-limit consumer still moved.
Two-producer chain and nine-node refusal controls after repair.
Live help, Force disclosure, clean no-op and duplicate identity controls.

limitations: Acceptance covers these reproducible synthetic workflows, not every graph topology or node class.
Wire length is an estimate, not rendered spline length; Force does not bypass safety refusals.
No automatic compilation or saving; no persistence or runtime behavior certification.
Shared producers, deeply nested comments and arbitrary graph types are not exhaustively tested.
